behavior: Theme reads seven volatile fields: preference, three bounded font sizes and three font lists. It prepends exact upstream head CSS/body script rows on every render and removes the listener on unload.

Font normalization follows JS whitespace/control filtering and quotes non-generic families; exact script bytes match fixed Source. Locale accepts open BCP47-style identifiers through a volatile optional reference.

Both companions own reversible optional Settings auto:false policies. Candidate bindings preserve historical providers; candidate application probe now serves/hash-records the actual fixed Source index instead of the production index.

cleanup.retained: Pair observations, commands/logs/XML, Source report, application errors and screenshots. Owned application homes, browser contexts and test workspaces removed.

limitations: No browser success or full visual parity is claimed; preview acknowledgement, Session-list wire shape and existing CSS anchor compatibility remain follow-up work.
Production bindings, pin, Portable, full regression and Win7 guest qualification are not promoted.
